messages:
Sara: Heads up — working on rollout UX for config changes that adjust routing weights + per-customer quotas. Need design for telemetry gating + enforcement window. cc @Kevin @Ana

Kevin: High-level: we need dry-run, telemetry gates (error rate + latency + token-cost drift), and an automatic rollback if gate trips. What's enforcement window meaning?

Sara: Enforcement window = period during which changes are permitted to affect live traffic; outside it changes are dry-run only. Idea: require ops approval to enable enforcement early. Default 1h.

Ana: Sounds reasonable. Telemetry gating: thresholds = increase in p95 latency > 15% OR error rate +0.5% OR token-cost drift > 10%? Need both absolute and relative checks.

Mike: Prefer per-route gates. Customer A traffic is noisy; global thresholds will false-positive. Can we gate at /api/v1/generate route-level histograms?

Julia: UX idea: in console show a "Preview in metrics" where we simulate effect using traffic replay for X% of traffic. Show expected token split + cost delta. Add toggle for "Auto-fallback if gate trips" and a summary card with likely impact.

Kevin: Implementation sketch: runtime-config service will support fields: dry_run, enforcement_window, telemetry_gates, sample_rate. Example shape to discuss:

```json
{"dry_run": false, "enforcement_window": {"duration_minutes": 60}, "telemetry_gates": [{"metric": "p95_latency_ms", "rel_increase_pct": 15}], "sample_rate": 0.05}
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release config-preview-service v1.3.2 queued by @Sara — staging -> canary -> prod. CI checks passed.

Sara: Question: how do we surface gate trip reasons in the rollout UI and in alerts? Need concise cause + config version + link to logs.

Ana: Alert payload should include: config_id, gate_hit_metric, current_value, baseline, affected_routes, sample_request_ids. Also set alert priority based on traffic volume impacted.

Mike: Edge case: when we route to fallback model variant, it's not a gate trip, but quality regressions might be silent. Add eval-set scoring tied to configs to detect quality drift (BLEU/embedding-sim thresholds or customer-defined evals).

Kevin: Agree. Also add TTL to temporary overrides so they auto-expire — prevents stale force-on flags.

Sara: I'll draft the console mockups + API RFC and assign reviewers @Kevin @Ana. Plan to land dry-run telemetry gating and enforcement-window support by next sprint. Thanks all.
